title: Co-borrower partner has to sign off
scenario: Jamal and his partner are buying together; Jamal is interested but says his partner is the co-borrower and needs to be on board. The rep stays compliant and schedules a joint call.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Hey Jamal, it's Erin from Copperleaf Home Loans. You and your partner were looking at duplexes?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, that's right. Live in one side, rent the other.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Love that strategy. Have you found anything you like yet?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: There's one on Maple we toured Sunday. It needs work but the numbers kind of make sense.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Nice. What kind of work are we talking?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Mostly cosmetic. The upstairs tenant has like eleven cats though, so, carpet's gotta go.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Oh no. Yeah, that's a full replacement.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Ha, yeah. Anyway, I'm into it, but Tasha's the co-borrower and she's way more cautious than me. I can't move on anything until she's on board.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Smart, you both need to be comfortable. What are her main concerns, do you know?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Mostly whether we can actually afford it if the rental side sits empty.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: That's a really good question, and it's something we can walk through with real numbers. Do you know if you'd want rental income counted toward qualifying?

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: I don't even know how that works. Can you count the rent?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: In a lot of cases a portion of the expected rent can be considered, but the specifics depend on the loan type and the property. I'd rather walk you both through it than guess.

utterances.speaker: client
utterances.text: Yeah, she'll want to hear that directly.

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Then let's get her on. Would tomorrow at lunch or Thursday evening be better for the two of you?

utterances.speaker: rep
utterances.text: Thursday at six-thirty. I'll send a link to both of you. If you can bring the listing and any rent info from the seller, that'd help.
